comment: Dr. Donald is the best! He is so organized with his lectures and notes. Made pchem very bearable and less scary. His exams are very fair!
Helpful in lab and cares. He gives guidance when you have questions but you have to think with him through all of it. Challenging but learn a lot because of it. He's funny too

Has a very dry sense of humor but he is hilarious. Very tough grader and not very helpful if you have a question because he wants you to figure it out on your own. Still a very nice man though and I would take lab with him again because you can tell he really wants you to do well.

As a lab professor, Dr. Donald is clear, consistent, and very fair. Like another review said, he's unintentionally hilarious and creates a super supportive lab environment. Cares a lot about his students and wants them to understand as much as possible. He's clearly an incredible chemist but can dumb down topics enough for virtually everyone. 10/10

Great professor and equally great guy. Knows his stuff and is experienced enough to be able to "dumb" topics down for everyone, even those new to chemistry. Start preparing for his tests a week before, and you're guaranteed an A. He's a picky grader so memorize definitions and principles exactly.

Great lab instructor. Very smart and knowledgeable. Unintentionally hilarious guy. Lab was actually a lot of fun this semester. Easy grader if you do the lab correctly and show some interest. Very friendly and easy to have a conversation with out of class. Definitely would recommend. He's also Jamaican.

Dr. Donald was a very good lab instructor and an overall nice guy! He was always willing to answer questions during lab and also help with the pre-lab and lab reports. He also doesn't grade too harshly compared to other lab instructors from what I've heard.
He makes the class entertaining, and very nice. Sometimes he is funny without trying to be.

Dr. Donald is a very nice man and is fair, he has trouble sometimes dumbing down the material for the students to understand, but he has gotten much better since he has started teaching.  He is always willing to help.  The tests are hard, but not impossible.  In another year I think he'll be one of the best in the department.

I had Dr. Donald for Chem 141 - which is basically the intro Chem course here. The course itself is hard, and fast-paced. This was Dr. Donald's first year, but he improved as the semester continued. His tests are hard, no scaling. He is really smart, but sometimes isn't clear getting the point across. He does try very hard and holds weekly reviews
